# FishModDungeons 1.7.18 **This release rebuilds the Custom Scoreboard and adds Enchant Colors, inventory command buttons, Fairy Soul waypoints, Slayer upgrades and 18 new secret achievements, along with a round of fixes.** [Discord](https://discord.gg/3mSuQUB8kk) · [Roadmap & bug reports](https://fishmod.dev/incoming-features) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Redfish247/FishModDungeons) --- ## Highlights - **Custom Scoreboard**: rebuilt with currencies, slayer, powder, mayor and party lines, rounded corners and screen anchors - **Enchant Colors**: per-tier enchant colours in tooltips with an optional chroma wave - **Inventory Buttons**: unlimited draggable command buttons and an equipment column - **Slayer**: always-on RNG Meter HUD, per-type stats with Elite rank and better profit pricing - **Achievements**: 18 new secret achievements with clues --- ## Changes
New Features - **Enchant Colors:** colours enchants in item tooltips by tier. The optional chroma mode flows across every enchant and tooltip line. - **Fairy Soul Waypoints:** shows uncollected souls on each island and clears them when found. - **World Render:** no fog, custom water colour, Ghost Box (with a filled option) and force others' size. - **Item Level Overlay:** book, pet, minion and cake levels on items, plus an obtained-date tooltip and an Exotic Armor tag. - **Quiver Warning:** title and sound when you are low on or out of arrows. - **Calendar Real Times:** real local date and time after each countdown in `/calendar`. - **Live Cosmetics:** a live connection to fishmod.dev, so nicks and cosmetics update instantly.
Dungeons - **Key Highlight:** box and optional tracer on dropped Wither and Blood keys. - **Room Checkmarks:** optional corner checkmarks on the map for cleared and all-secrets rooms. - **Dungeon Waypoints:** import Odin waypoint packs or a `/dwp` export string. - **Ragnarock:** strength-gained notification with a party chat option. - **F7 phases:** P3 now starts on the first terminal, device or lever even if Goldor's line was missed.
Slayer - **RNG Meter:** now an always-on HUD. - **Slayer Stats:** XP, kills and time per slayer type, lifetime numbers from the API and your Elite leaderboard rank. - **Slayer Profit:** prices runes and hunting shards, colours items by rarity and only counts loot on the quest's island.
Mining & Diana - **Corpse Highlight:** highlights corpses, no longer through walls. - **Mining Profit:** subtracts key cost for Umber, Tungsten and Vanguard corpses. - **Crown of Avarice:** HUD only shows while Diana is active. - **Diana Message Hider:** per-message toggles.
Scoreboard - **Custom Scoreboard:** fully rebuilt. Date, time and server on their own lines, SkyBlock level, Gems and Soulflow from the tab list, slayer, powder, mayor, party and island guest count, with a custom footer. - **Layout:** corner radius slider, smooth rounded background and a position dropdown with six screen anchors.
Menu & UI - **Inventory Buttons:** unlimited icon and name command buttons with HUD-style snapping, plus an equipment column that follows loadout swaps. Edit them from the mod menu. - **Hide HUDs Under Tab:** hides mod HUDs that overlap the tab list while it is open. - **HUD Text Shadow:** global Per Feature / Always / Never override. - **HUD Editor:** example previews for Rift Guide, Dungeon Map, RNG Meter, Achievement Popup and more. - **Storage:** search bar caret, selection and text hotkeys. - **Chat Filter:** per-type spam toggles and a Guild MOTD toggle. - **Experiment Solver:** reworked for Chronomatron, Ultrasequencer and Superpairs, including powerups. - **Update Notice:** clickable chat message by default, popup optional. ...

# FishModDungeons 1.7.0 **This release adds Minecraft 26.2 support, an Achievements system, new Kuudra, Farming and Rift tabs, a built-in Profile Viewer, Chat Filter, the F7 Terminal Tracker and Necron drop prediction, along with a large round of fixes and performance work.** [Discord](https://discord.gg/3mSuQUB8kk) · [Roadmap & bug reports](https://fishmod.dev/incoming-features) · [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Redfish247/FishModDungeons) --- ## Highlights - **Minecraft 26.2**: FishModDungeons now runs on 26.1.2 and 26.2 - **Achievements**: trophy-case menu, difficulty ratings and Hub leaderboards - **Kuudra, Farming and Rift tabs**: full suites for each, from auto requeue to pest finding to Bacte - **Floor 7**: Terminal Tracker, Necron drop prediction and ranked dragon timers - **Profile Viewer**: browse any player's profile in game - **Chat Filter**: hide Hypixel spam with your own partial, exact or regex rules --- ## Changes
New Features - **Minecraft 26.2:** FishModDungeons now ships for both 26.1.2 and 26.2. On 26.2, world highlights draw through vanilla gizmos so water, glass and leaves can't cover them. - **Achievements:** a full achievement system with a trophy-case screen (`/fm ach`). Achievements are grouped by section with tinted icons and a difficulty on every tile. Unlocking one shows a popup banner with a sound. Playtime achievements read your `/playtime` reply, and RNG achievements are fed from the existing trackers. - **Achievement leaderboards:** two leaderboard boards in the Hub (points and secrets) with gold, silver and bronze top-3 names. The full top 100 is in the achievements menu. - **Profile Viewer:** a built-in profile viewer (from BetterPV) with networth, dungeons, museum, pets, wardrobe, sacks and more. It is skipped automatically when the standalone FishPV mod is installed. - **Chat Filter:** hides common Hypixel spam (built from real chat logs). Add your own lines with partial, exact or regex matching, and import your hide-only notification rules. It has its own editor tab in Chat & Commands, opened with `/fm chatfilter` (`/fm cf`). Abiphone rings are folded into one line, and hidden lines are still written to the log. - **Stopwatch:** a HUD timer with configurable start, stop, split and reset triggers and keybinds. - **Slayer Carry Tracker:** `/trackcarry [amount]` tracks boss kills for the players you carry, with a HUD. Bosses are matched by name and tier and attributed to the nearest tracked player. Carries clear when you leave the slayer islands. - **RNG Meter Title:** shows the RNG Meter chat line as an on-screen title. - **Experimentation Table tracker:** a profit tracker HUD for experiments, with rarity colours and per-experiment rates on Superpairs. - **Anita Medal Profit:** shows coins per bronze medal in Anita's shop and highlights the best item. - **Container Value sidebar:** the Storage Overlay shows a value sidebar with item tooltips, a green slot highlight on hover and the total in the header. In the Rift it shows motes instead of coins. - **Recipe Viewer:** hold Shift on an item to open its NEU recipe. It uses real Hypixel item models, has recipe tabs, and shows a hold bar with a Shift indicator. - **Item Customization:** NEU skins and Hypixel dyes. **See Others' Items** is back: custom dye, trim, model and name are shared and shown on other FishMod users. - **Report button:** the FishMod menu has a Report button for bugs and feature requests, also available as `/fm bug` and `/fm suggest`. Reports go straight to the FishMod inbox. - **Mayor:** data refreshes at every term switch. Adds a Force Paul info HUD toggle. The Diana year now requires the Mythological Ritual perk. - **Help Carrolyn:** a tooltip hint with a right-click warp to the Crimson Isle.

# FishModDungeons 1.6.83

This release adds full Diana support, a new Mining tab, Zoom, a reworked /fm menu and updates for the Alpha F7/M7 changes, along with many fixes.

## New Features
- **Diana:** full burrow helper. It covers spade and arrow guessing, warp keys and hints, rare mob alerts and party sharing, loot and mob trackers, announcers, the Sphinx solver and a Crown of Avarice counter.
- **Mining tab:** Crystal Nucleus boxes, shaft pity, gemstone lines, fossil solver, profit tracker, ability cooldowns, commissions, powder chests, and corpse/shaft announcements.
- **Zoom:** hold C (rebindable) to zoom. Scroll while holding to zoom from 1.5x to 50x. Includes a base zoom slider and optional Smooth Zoom and Smooth Camera.
- **Mob Hit Sound (Melee):** plays a sound only when your melee hit actually registers, including ferocity procs and one-shot kills. You can pick the sound, volume and pitch, and optionally mute the vanilla attack sounds.
- **Storm LB Waypoint (Floor 7):** Archer and Healer get a marker on their lightning bolt pad and an aim box during P2 until Storm dies. `/fm stormlb archer|healer|off` previews it anywhere.
- **Hide Objective (Render Optimizer):** hides the "Objective:" boss bar, such as the Rift mushroom race bar.
- **Default colour option:** every colour picker has a Default row that restores the built-in colour.

## Menu & UI
- **/fm column stack:** a tab strip on the left lists every column. Click to fold or unfold a column, drag to reorder, and right-click a merged tab to show its columns. Fold state is saved.
- **Menu animations:** columns opened from the stack drop in smoothly. The controls hint moved to the bottom-left, and arrows are drawn smoothly across the mod.
- **HUD editor:** Esc now saves and closes, the same as Done. Ctrl+Z and R still undo and reset.
- **Inventory [Reset] buttons:** session trackers (Mining Profit, Diana Loot/Mob, Slayer Profit, Crown) show a two-click Reset while your inventory is open. All-time totals are never reset.
- **Tab hides trackers:** tracker HUDs hide while you hold Tab, the same as the dungeon map.

## Dungeons
- **Alpha F7/M7 support:** Simon Says with 4 rounds, the new Watcher and Necron dialogue, detection of the new terminal layouts (Numbers, Melody lanes), and the Dragon HUD listing every spawning dragon.
- **F7/M7 timers:** lightning, Py and terminal start timers are updated to the new values.
- **M7 P5 start:** P5 now starts when the first Corrupted Relic spawns, and the relic countdown ends when the relic stands appear.
- **Blood splits:** M7 Blood Open and Blood Clear splits trigger when the blood door opens.
- **Secret Clicked:** wither essence clicks that were missed now count.
- **Leap menu:** player heads show up immediately instead of briefly showing "No players found".
- **!dt requeue:** restored chat history from mods like ChatPatches can no longer trigger a requeue skip.

## Diana
- **Guess accuracy:** fixed far guesses flickering and disappearing, which also affected arrow guesses. Guesses snap to grass and stay steady.
- **Sub guesses:** clicking a wrong guess moves to the next sub guess, and digging a burrow clears nearby sub guesses.
- **Warp priority:** rare mob waypoints beat the nearest burrow for warp keys and hints. Nothing warps while you're halfway through a nearby burrow.
- **Movable titles:** the warp title and rare mob alert are their own HUD elements you can move and scale. The warp title fades out as soon as you warp.
- **Received rare mobs:** a party share always shows the title and plays the sound.
- **Diana Profit screen (`/fm dianaloot`):** pick past events with year chips (Single select option), with total profit, per hour, burrows per hour, mob count, and a searchable drop list with icons. It has its own scale slider.
- **Import From SBO:** adds your SkyblockOverhaul totals and past years to FishMod's tracker. Pressing it twice counts your totals twice.

# FishModDungeons 1.5.42 (MC 26.1.2)

Changes since 1.4.44.

## New features
- **Auto-updater**: checks GitHub releases on each Hypixel login and shows an in-game update popup. It downloads the new jar, backs up the old one, and applies the update on restart. If the browser can't open, the link goes to chat instead.
- **HUD Editor v2**: live HUD previews, snapping, a resize grip, undo/redo, Tab to select, centering, and a sidebar with search and category picking. Every HUD is listed, including Custom Scoreboard and Dungeon Score Title.
- **New UI renderer**: NanoVG is replaced with FishMod's own shaders. The secondary screens are redesigned, and a new GUI Settings screen has per-screen scales. Storage Viewer/Overlay scrolls smoothly.
- **Timers & alerts**: Necron LB Timer, Py Tick Timer, Storm Over Alert, Ice Spray Timer, Quiz Timer HUD, Veno Stack Count HUD, and a Storm Over 5s countdown.
- **Player Highlight / Class Colored Glow**: teammates glow in their class colours, through walls.
- **Secret Overlay**: shows the secrets found in the current room on screen.
- **Pet Swap Title**, plus Pet HUD and Invincibility timer options to show icons instead of names. Invincibility procs show a title per mask, with custom text, colour and sound.
- **Pet Keybinds**: bind keys to specific pets. They only work inside a Pets menu you opened yourself.
- **Slot Locking**: locks inventory slots against drops, with tint opacity and outline options.
- **Positional Messages**: waypoint blocks that send a party message when you step on them.
- **Relic Times**: lists all 5 M7 relic place times and who placed each one.
- **Players Leaped HUD** (replaces the S4 tracker), **Performance HUD** (FPS/TPS/ping), and **Dungeon Breaker charges HUD** with a break sound.
- **PBs & splits**: Storm Kill added to PB messages, `/pbsplits` (sum of your best splits), `/splitspb`, tick-time PB splits, and resetting split PBs/averages per floor or for all floors.
- **Route Recorder** (temporary): records routes per room, including Superboom TNT, and auto-plays them when you enter that room.
- **Hide Terminal Titles**: hides Hypixel titles and subtitles during P3 terminals. It has a toggle in the F7 settings.
- **Loot tracker** shows real item icons, including resource-pack textures.

## Solvers & dungeon fixes
- Melody solver highlights the target column instead of the top-row pane.
- Blaze solver: no longer marks a wrong-order fail as solved, re-arms after an Architect's reset, draws crisp lines, adds a third blaze colour, can hide blaze mobs, and sends a reliable completion message.
- Quiz solver highlights the answer from anywhere in the room.
- Boulder solver can render click blocks through walls.
- TP Maze marks the pad you stepped on correctly.
- Simon Says HUD tracks the stage the Noamm way.
- Door Highlight got a large rework: key-door progression, fairy door handling, an Outline Only mode, and wither/blood doors staying green until you walk through.
- The dungeon map scans rooms before the run starts, and room secrets show found/total.
- Fixed the dragon split for blue+purple. Secret item/bat detection now works like Odin's, and only wither essence and redstone key skulls count as secrets.
- Storm Kill counts only the first crush and uses server-tick time.
- Warp Cooldown starts when you land in the instance.
- Fixed Blessing Display showing a stale Time value.
- LB Release Timer: healer end time changed to 34.10s. Ice Spray freeze (5s) and M7 relic spawn (42 ticks) are now fixed values.

## Party
- Kick/promote targets are learned from party chat, `/p list` and Party Finder joins, and are kept across worlds.
- The Kick List catches Party Finder joins.
- Other party members can trigger `.ai` / `!allinv` if you give them party-action permission.

## UI / rendering fixes
- Thick outlines no longer draw through walls, and water no longer paints over box fills.
- Fixed see-through waypoint text swimming as you move. Route lines stay attached while crouching.

# FishModDungeons v1.0.31

Active development is on **dungeons-26.1.2** (Mojang mappings, MC 26.1.2). **dungeons-1.21.11** is
now frozen — its final build (v1.0.31) is attached below for anyone who still wants it, but it
won't receive further updates.

## Highlights since 1.0.9

- **Kotlin port** of the entire mod (common + both dungeon modules).
- **Dungeon Map**, ported from System22: rooms, doors, score tracking, secrets, deaths, mimic/prince
  detection, HUD position/scale settings, legit-mode door highlighting, and a full NanoVG-rendered
  settings panel.
- **/dwp dungeon waypoint editor** (OdinLegacy-style), plus refined waypoint UX.
- **NanoVG rendering** ported in and rolled out across the mod's screens (FishModScreen, Command
  Keys/Aliases, Credits, Loot Tracker, and the item customize screen) for smoother, higher-quality
  UI instead of vanilla GuiGraphics.
- **Item Customize screen**: restored the classic flat layout (armor/inventory picker, name/dye/
  trim, clickable `&`-code legend with `&*` star insertion) and added a Model field for reskinning
  items (e.g. an AOTV rendering as a trident).
- **Loot Tracker (/fmloot)**: auto-detects Croesus chest drops, redesigned overlay UI.
- **Dupe class detection** with an ignore-mage option and a "To Party" alert option.
- **Party Finder join-stats lookup** (MP/PB/Cata/Gear) on incoming whispers.
- **Customizable starred mob highlight** for dungeons.
- **Public extension API** so companion mods can register their own `/fm` toggles — Legit Mode /
  Insight Legit for the dungeon map now live exclusively behind that extension; the core mod always
  forces legit mode back on at every server join.
- Assorted fixes: pet overlay reliability, starred-mob detection, door-highlight rendering, Command
  Aliases/Keys screens, Goldor Splits panel overlap, and more.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/Redfish247
